name: bar
description: A bar round: finders read each area, a skeptic verifies each finding against the code, blind judges apply the bar to the confirmed in batches, Claude decides; the seen list keeps earlier rounds' findings out

bar.default: real users lose work, get a false result, are blocked on a core path, or see an action they didn't ask for

seen.description: earlier rounds' findings, one per line: not reported again

stages.prompt:
Check this finding against the code at {base}; reproduce it if you can:

{item}
